title: Parallel-plate channel with uniform wall heat flux: Nu = 140/17 (analytic)
description:
Laminar flow + heat (fluid_heat_convection), time-dependent march to the steady state (steady flow, transient heat from T_in for 4 flow-through times; a stationary Picard loop diverges here: with only the inflow face holding T, the lagged advection has gain ~ 2 Pe L / (pi H) ~ 20 on the axial mode): a liquid enters a 21 um channel (21 cells, centre cell on the centreline) with the fully developed parabolic profile of mean U_m (velocity inlet x_lo, pressure 0 at x_hi, no-slip y faces; the steady flow march starts at that developed profile and linear pressure by initial_velocity, since from rest one pressure face makes it slow) at T_in (held on x_lo); both walls feed the same heat flux q (heat_flux on y_lo / y_hi), the outlet is insulated. L = 8 H, Pe = U_m H / a = 4.
Analytic (thermally fully developed: at Pe = 4 the entry modes decay within ~H, the outlet's within ~H upstream): dT/dx = G_T = 2 q / (rho cp U_m H) everywhere, T(x, eta) = T_b(x) + (q H / k) (17/70 + 2 eta^3 - eta^4 - eta), eta = y / H, T_b the mixing-cup (velocity-weighted) mean; so T_wall - T_b = (17/70) q H / k, Nu = q 2H / (k (T_wall - T_b)) = 140/17 = 8.235, and T_wall - T_centre = (5/16) q H / k. Axial conduction (Pe = 4) does not change the developed profile but lets heat leak back through the held inlet, so the level of T_b(x) has no closed form: every temperature check is a difference.
Derived values tab (column at x = 4 H): dT_wall_centre (wall cell minus centre cell) vs (q H / k) (f(eta_w) + 5/16), and dT_wall_bulk (wall cell minus the discrete mixing-cup mean enthalpy_column / flow_column = sum u T / sum u of the column: the column's own flow rate, since the lattice Boltzmann flow rate there differs from U_m H by ~0.2 %, which times T_rise ~ 2 K would shift the 0.23 K difference by ~2 %) vs (q H / k) (f(eta_w) + 17/70) = the Nusselt check (Nu_wall-cell = 2 q H / (k dT_wall_bulk) vs 140/17 / (1 + (70/17) f(eta_w))), f(eta) = 2 eta^3 - eta^4 - eta at the wall-cell centre eta_w = dx / (2 H); dTdx_centre (centreline slope between x = 3 H and 5 H) vs G_T (the energy balance); p_inlet (pressure at the first cell centre) vs G_p (L - dx/2). Expected ~1e-3 (second-order FV conduction (dx/H)^2, the discrete inlet shape normalised to cell mean 1); tolerances 1 % / 0.5 % / 2 %.
Line profile tab: u_profile (u_x across at x = 4 H: the discrete parabola U_m eta (1 - eta) / (1/6 + (dx/H)^2 / 12) of the inlet) and p_profile (linear pressure along the centreline, G_p = 2 mu U_m / ((1/6 + (dx/H)^2 / 12) H^2)).

parameters.name: Pe
parameters.description: Peclet number U_m H / a

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: rho_f
parameters.description: liquid density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: k_f
parameters.description: liquid thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: cp_f
parameters.description: liquid specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: a_f
parameters.description: thermal diffusivity in m^2/s (1.5e-7)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform square cell size

parameters.name: H_ch
parameters.description: channel height (odd cell count: the centre cell sits on the centreline)

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: channel length

parameters.name: U_m
parameters.description: mean inflow velocity in m/s (0.029; Reynolds ~0.6)

parameters.name: q_w
parameters.description: heat flux into the liquid through each wall in W/m^2

parameters.name: T_in
parameters.description: inflow temperature in K (held on x_lo; also the heat T0, so T_rise = T - T_in)

parameters.name: qHk
parameters.description: temperature scale q H / k in K (1.05)

parameters.name: G_T
parameters.description: developed axial temperature gradient in K/m (energy balance)

parameters.name: shape_mean
parameters.description: cell-centre mean of eta (1 - eta): the inlet's discrete parabola is normalised to it

parameters.name: G_p
parameters.description: pressure gradient magnitude of that parabola in Pa/m

parameters.name: dt_heat
parameters.description: transient heat step in s (peak u dt / dx = 0.9: the lagged advection stays stable)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: march duration in s (4 flow-through times: the start-up front has left the channel)

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: lower edge of the checked cell column

parameters.name: eta_w
parameters.description: eta of the wall-cell centre

parameters.name: f_w
parameters.description: profile shape 2 eta^3 - eta^4 - eta at the wall-cell centre (0 at the wall, -5/16 at the centre)

parameters.name: dT_wc_ref
parameters.description: analytic wall-cell minus centre-cell temperature in K

parameters.name: dT_wb_ref
parameters.description: analytic wall-cell minus mixing-cup temperature in K
